0:
SELECT MAX(
    (T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / T1."Enrollment (K-12)")
) AS "Max Eligible Free Rate"
FROM "frpm" AS T1
JOIN "schools" AS T2 ON T1."CDSCode" = T2."CDSCode"
WHERE T2."County" = 'Alameda'	----- bird -----	california_schools
1:
SELECT "frpm"."School Name"
FROM "frpm"
WHERE "frpm"."School Type" = 'Continuation' AND "frpm"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY ("frpm"."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "frpm"."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") ASC
LIMIT 3	----- bird -----	california_schools
2: SELECT T2."Zip" FROM "frpm" AS T1 INNER JOIN "schools" AS T2 ON T1."CDSCode" = T2."CDSCode" WHERE T1."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 AND T1."County Name" = 'Fresno County'	----- bird -----	california_schools
